name: and everything is quiet on these desolate wastes
source:
you are a hunter who has traveled north to the desolate wastes, a stretch of tundra in a fictional world. your task is to bring game home to your community to prove your worth.

[From [url=https://catsket.itch.io/desolatewastes]itch.io[/url]]
